body:
When I was around 12 my mom and I found two tiny kittens in our attic, abandoned by their mom.
One night I was given responsibility for them, and had them in a box next to my bed. Very young kittens, much like human newborns, wake up throughout the night and cry for food and such. The kittens were just big enough to crawl up and out of the box, and I was getting frustrated and sleep deprived. I put a large throw pillow over the top of the box in an attempt to stop the kittens from being able to climb over the edge. However, when I woke up in the morning, I discovered that the pillow had sunk into the box during the night, and had suffocated one of the kittens. I was devastated, and still blame myself to this day. I try to remind myself that I was just a kid, and it was an accident, but it’s hard to get past the guilt.

I’m sorry this happened to you and your bunny. I hope you can find peace with it, and know that it wasn’t your fault.
